say:3:1511238001:0.text: What happened? Why did you summon us so suddenly?

say:5:1511238003:0.text: Tilaya, didn't you tell me yesterday that the rumors were false?

say:7:1511238004:0.text: ... We're going to explain why they're false, you idiot!

say:13:1511238006:0.text: Good day, everyone. I'm sure you've all heard rumors about Utopia, to some extent.
say:13:1511238006:0.source_cn: 诸位，日安。想必大家或多或少听说过理想乡的传言。

say:14:1511238007:0.text: But today I tell you this: Utopia truly exists, but it's actually called the Dark Forest. The mage beside me has journeyed there.

say:16:1511238008:0.text: He has confirmed that the <style="highlight">Arcadian Rift doesn't lead to any paradise</style>. The rift's chaotic magic is lethal. That is the reason why none of our loved ones ever returned.

say:19:1511238010:0.source_cn: 什……什么？！理想乡真的存在？要怎么去？！

say:22:1511238011:0.text: Wait, you're telling us that we can really go there?

say:30:1511238015:1.text: Before, it was the Halians who kept us in chains. Today, it's Kordan. He was supposed to be our kin... our brother. That's what makes this cut so much deeper.

say:31:1511238016:1.text: Nazrik is gone. The dam's broken. You think he'll be the only one?
say:31:1511238016:1.source_cn: 那非已经走了，只要有路，会有更多人走。

say:32:1511238017:0.text: If there's a way out, I'll take it.

say:36:1511238019:0.text: I also want to know where this utopia is and how to get there...
say:36:1511238019:0.source_cn: 我……我也想知道理想乡到底在哪，怎样才能过去……

say:40:1511238021:1.text: But Halftail is right! I'd rather go somewhere else than stay in Mirehold and be called a weakling!
